newsitem.title: INDONESIA: JAKARTA STOCKS REBOUND AT CLOSE ON TELKOM.
newsitem.headline: JAKARTA STOCKS REBOUND AT CLOSE ON TELKOM.

text.p: Jakarta stocks rebounded on Tuesday and closed higher after six trading days of losses on fresh buying in Telkom, brokers said.
The Jakarta composite index was up 4.78 points, or 0.73 percent, to close at 662.95 points. The index had fallen to 647.17 points in the morning on the weak rupiah.
Decliners led advancers by 68 to 58 with 57 issues unchanged.
Total turn-over was estimated at 455 billion rupiah.
"It's the fresh buying in Telkom which led the index to rebound," one broker said.
Reports that some 1.6 million, or 30 percent, of Telkom's 5.6 million installed fixed telephone line capacity had not been sold yet did not have much impact on Telkom, brokers said.
"It's not unusual as the utilisation rate is usually at around 70 percent," Widodo said.
Other big-capitalised stocks which rebounded in afternoon trading includedd Citra Marga, Bank Danamon and Gudang Garam.
